title: Subject–Predicate–Object Structural Intelligence (SPO-SI): Subject-Centric World Models, Governed Action, and Recursive Structural Evolution
description:
SPO-SI is an open research incubator exploring subject–predicate–object intelligence loops that connect intelligent subjects, world models, governed action, feedback, and recursive structural evolution.

The v0.1.0 release presents a conceptual architecture for subject-centric and shared world models; structural relay and perspective-transformation interfaces; evidence and counter-evidence exchange; evaluation sovereignty; and governed structural self-improvement. It includes six research papers, four proposed relay specifications, open questions, testable hypotheses, a validation roadmap, and architectural figures.

Research status: The framework and interfaces are exploratory proposals. This release does not claim experimental validation, proven performance improvements, a complete theory of world models, or a theory of consciousness. The project invites independent tests, counterexamples, and collective structural learning.

Guiding principle: SPO-SI is not an attempt to own the world of intelligence, but an attempt to connect intelligent subjects, their models, their actions, and their structural evolution.

Repository: GitHub.
